title: Abby Williams, the Lions Club and the Illinois Club
summary: Jobs with Abby Williams, Mardi Gras clubs he led for, and the Illinois Club where he started.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: What about Abby Williams? Did you ever work with Abby, Spann?

Yeah, I worked with Abby a lot. Worked with Abby a lot, little jobs. Where? Well down around Paul Good and Burgundy, and Paul Good around the corner in 59. When I first began to get into the air like that, I was working with him down there then.
I used to come to Thump and Manor's and hear you and dance, remember?
On the patio. The patio, yeah. The Lions Club, didn't you play that one?
Oh yeah, that used to be my club. Yeah, I worked there for the years. I was in charge of both of the bands.
Was that for Mardi Gras? For Mardi Gras.

It had two bands, huh? It had two bands. The Lions Club there. Until I started to go out and rejoice and I gave it up. You played a lot of Mardi Gras parades then? Oh yeah, I played many, many, many parades.
What other clubs did you work for?

The Illinois Club, that's my first club. I played with Willie Parker's band. He used to get the job at the time he used to play the bass drum. I used to work with his band. I mean he'd get the job, you know, Moose never got the job that was their band.
And so I got to know the people in the Illinois Club. And I played for the Buzzards.
